title: Signed Extensions of a Respite and Short-Term Stay
content:
When the guest or a financial representative signs an extension request registered on the stay, the planned departure date moves to the requested date and the added nights are booked as one extension segment whose amount is the extension charge. This applies to every stay under the Respite and Short-Term Stay Agreement.

## Rule

Where the stay type on record differs from the stay type the stay was booked as, added nights are not booked until the stay's records carry a level-change segment billing the stay type on record.

Stated in its two cases:

| Stay type on record against the stay type booked | Added nights booked by a signed extension |
|---|---|
| The same | This condition does not arise |
| Different | Not booked until the stay's records carry a level-change segment billing the stay type on record |

## What signing does

- The extension request is marked signed.
- The stay's planned departure date moves to the date stated on the request, and the stay's extension count rises by one.
- One nightly charge entry with the basis extension is recorded, covering the added nights from the old planned departure date up to the new planned departure date, that date itself not included, at the stay type on record.
- The stay balance rises by the extension charge; the signer sees the new departure date and the extension charge on the stay statement.

## How it is invoked

The signature is given with the customer-side tool `sign_stay_extension_37758bab`. The agent unlocks the tool and hands it over; the customer themselves — the guest or the guest's financial representative — runs it to sign.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `customer_id` | Reference number of the guest the stay belongs to, as returned by the customer lookup | Identifier |
| `respite_stay_id` | Reference number of the respite or trial stay being extended, as returned by the stay lookup | Identifier |
| `respite_request_id` | Reference number of the extension request awaiting signature, as returned by the stay request lookup | Identifier |
| `extension_charge` | Amount charged for the added nights in USD | Positive number with 2 decimal places, already rounded half up to the cent |

## Return

A confirmation sentence naming the signed request reference number, the new extension charge entry reference number, the stay reference number, the new planned departure date (YYYY-MM-DD), the added nights, the extension charge in USD with 2 decimal places and the resulting stay balance. A returned entry reference number means the extension was signed and booked.
